issues.symptom: Contemporary mid-century aesthetic does not strongly embody Japandi principles; lacks minimalist restraint, natural textures, and zen-like calm characteristic of Japandi fusion
Palette leans warm/traditional (cream, wood tones) rather than cool-neutral with warm accents typical of Japandi; insufficient use of greiges, soft grays, or muted earth tones
Style application feels generic contemporary rather than specifically tailored to this room's existing architectural features (crown molding, window placement, wall color)
While clean, lacks the refined, curated editorial polish of high-end interior design photography; styling feels student-project rather than professional publication
Original photograph demonstrates superior spatial authenticity, material authenticity, and personal curation; render reads as generic despite technical competence
